about.title: About Me
about.description: Full-Stack & Mobile Software Engineer (B.Sc. Trakya, 2024; M.Sc. ongoing) specializing in high-performance web, cross-platform mobile, and edge/IoT systems. Core stack spans TypeScript, Next.js (16), React Native, Kotlin, Node.js, and PostgreSQL/Supabase. Proven track record architecting resilient systems end-to-end—from low-level OS hardware concurrency and native Android bridges to zero-trust financial state machines and privacy-preserving AI compliance pipelines.

technologies: React Native / Expo (Native Modules, MMKV, Notifee)

projects.title: Ultimarket
projects.subtitle: Edge POS, Telemetry & Real-Time Analytics Engine
projects.summary: Multithreaded Python USB HID barcode daemon, 90s idle-timeout basket state machine (<50ms latency), 2,000+ item PostgreSQL/Prisma catalog, NVIDIA NIM Vision invoice OCR & keyboard-first credit (veresiye) ledger.
projects.description: End-to-end Edge POS, Telemetry & Real-Time Analytics Engine designed to bridge closed physical retail checkouts to a cloud operations console. Built around a multithreaded Python USB HID barcode daemon with zero dropped inputs, a 90s idle-timeout basket state machine (<50ms sync latency), a 2,000+ item PostgreSQL/Prisma catalog, NVIDIA NIM Vision invoice OCR, and a keyboard-first credit (veresiye) ledger.
highlights: Multithreaded Python USB HID barcode daemon capturing OS-level scanner inputs with zero dropped scans.
90s idle-timeout basket state machine and ESC hardware shortcut delivering <50ms sub-second telemetry sync.
2,000+ item PostgreSQL/Prisma catalog paired with NVIDIA NIM Vision invoice OCR automation.
Keyboard-first credit (veresiye) ledger and dark-mode real-time retail analytics console.
projects.privacyNotice: Live public links are restricted due to commercial data privacy policies as this system operates in active retail production.

projects.title: Numbrias
projects.subtitle: Multi-Sided 3D Printing & Digital Model Marketplace
projects.summary: Strict order lifecycle state machine (pending -> delivered) with idempotent payment webhooks, STL/3MF private storage IP protection, zero-trust app_metadata RBAC, and 327 automated tests across a 118-route build.
projects.description: Multi-sided 3D printing and digital model marketplace architected with Next.js 16 (App Router, RSC, PPR), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, Private Storage), Zod, Three.js, and Playwright. Features a strict order lifecycle state machine (pending -> delivered) with idempotent payment webhooks and atomic refund compensation chains, STL/3MF IP protection via private storage signed URLs and zero-trust app_metadata RBAC with PII masking, verified by 313 unit/integration tests (node:test) and 14 Playwright E2E suites securing a 118-route build.
highlights: Strict order lifecycle state machine (pending -> paid -> slicing -> printing -> shipped -> delivered) with idempotent payment webhooks and atomic refund compensation chains.
STL/3MF intellectual property protection using Supabase Private Storage signed URLs, zero-trust app_metadata RBAC, and PII masking.
313 unit/integration tests (node:test) and 14 Playwright E2E suites securing a 118-route production build.

projects.description: End-to-end multi-tenant digital health ecosystem comprising a React Native / Expo patient application, a Next.js clinic and admin dashboard, and PharmaGuard AI—an automated Turkish SUT/SGK pharmacy regulation compliance engine using Google Gemini OCR with automated pre-inference PII redaction (TCKN and patient identifiers sanitized prior to model calls), QR patient onboarding, lab-report visualizers, medication adherence, and Supabase RLS & RBAC.
highlights: Multi-tenant patient app (Expo / React Native) and Next.js clinic/admin portal backed by Supabase RLS & RBAC.
PharmaGuard AI engine checking Turkish SUT/SGK prescription rules via Gemini OCR with automated pre-inference PII sanitization.
QR-code patient onboarding, real-time lab result visualizers, medication reminders, and duty-pharmacy tracking.

projects.title: Wakelarm
projects.subtitle: Native-Hybrid Android Alarm & Cognitive Wake-Up App
projects.summary: Custom native Kotlin modules (AlarmRingingActivity, AlarmAudioModule) with AlarmManager & Full-Screen Intent bypassing JS cold-start delay, USAGE_ALARM audio isolation, and on-device vision/motion dismissal tasks.
projects.description: Native-hybrid Android alarm and cognitive wake-up application built with React Native (0.88), Expo (SDK 58), TypeScript, Kotlin, NativeWind, Zustand, MMKV, Notifee, and AdMob. Eliminates JS bridge cold-start latency via custom native Kotlin modules (AlarmRingingActivity, AlarmAudioModule) using AlarmManager and Full-Screen Intent (FLAG_SHOW_WHEN_LOCKED), enforces system-level USAGE_ALARM audio isolation, and requires on-device barcode/QR scanning, accelerometer push-up/shake detection, or math tasks to dismiss.
highlights: Custom native Kotlin modules (AlarmRingingActivity, AlarmAudioModule) backed by AlarmManager & Full-Screen Intent (FLAG_SHOW_WHEN_LOCKED) for 0ms JS cold-start wait.
System-level USAGE_ALARM audio stream isolation ensuring reliable wake playback over media/silent states.
Cognitive wake-up missions: on-device barcode/QR verification, accelerometer push-up/shake detection, and math challenges.

blog.title: Next.js ile İlk Uygulamanızı 10 Dakikada Kurun: App Router Dönemine Giriş
blog.description: Next.js 13+ App Router özellikleri ile projenize hızlı bir başlangıç yapın.
